run_colmap_inference: run MapAnything inference on COLMAP reconstruction data with images and sparse folder
load_colmap_data: load COLMAP format data from a folder with images and sparse subfolders
export_colmap_predictions: export MapAnything predictions to COLMAP format with voxel downsampling options
export_glb_scene: export MapAnything predictions as a GLB 3D scene file with processed images
visualize_rerun: visualize MapAnything COLMAP inference results using Rerun 3D visualization
